# GSAP runtime

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0 are bundled locally, unchanged, from the official
npm package https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.0.tgz.
The archive's SHA-512 integrity was checked against npm registry metadata.

Both distribution files retain GreenSock's copyright and standard license notice:
https://gsap.com/standard-license/. They require no external runtime request.

Scroll implementation references:
https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/
https://gsap.com/docs/v3/GSAP/gsap.matchMedia()/
